QF.id: VIII Sales Practices and Investor Protection Services_7

answer.text: SEBI's web-based centralized complaints redressal system through which investors can lodge complaints online, receive acknowledgement, track status, and have the complaint forwarded to the concerned entity with an Action Taken Report uploaded back to SEBI
A credit scoring system for investors
A trading platform operated by SEBI
A software for calculating derivative payoffs

explanation.text: The Logic: SCORES is SEBI's web-based centralized complaints redressal system. Investors can file complaints online, receive an acknowledgement, track status, and the complaint is forwarded to the concerned entity which uploads an Action Taken Report. Per the NISM Series VIII workbook, the concerned entity is required to resolve the complaint within 21 days after intimation by SEBI. The Trap: SCORES is not a credit scoring system, a trading platform, or a payoff calculator — those distractors share the "S" / "score" cue but describe entirely different systems. Note: The explanation's resolution timeline was corrected from the previous "within 30 days" to "within 21 days after SEBI intimation" to match the NISM Series VIII workbook. The unsupported Cross-Exam Context and Pro-Tip paragraphs were removed.
